chronology: Declared after negative native and owner controls, before any current-cost candidate completes and before any finalist stress outcome.

current_cost_candidates.fixed_relative_rule: 1.5 times the exact declared normal execution fee; normal execution slippage plus10basispoints.

four_stresses_each_finalist: One extra completed bar of latency: two bars total from decision to immediate scheduled actual execution open; absent required candle expires
Native volume-capacity participation reduced from1percent to0.1percent
unchanged_selector_features: Do not recompute selector eligibility or price-opportunity hurdles from stressed execution costs. Preserve the exact finalist source/config and frozen feature costs to isolate execution sensitivity.
qualification: Positive whole-account marked PnL, independent full accounting PASS, and drawdown no worse than the corresponding original primary owner/cost control. At most two finalists selected under the frozen ranking; no minimum count is required.
interpretation: Stress outcomes test absolute profitability and drawdown robustness. No cost-matched stressed control is included, so they do not establish a matched causal relative-improvement claim. If no candidate qualifies, all eight stresses remain gated.
admission: Separate immutable stress adapter/source, causal actual-bar execution fixtures and independent review are required before any historical stress. Original normal-run sources/protocols stay frozen.
